d: France is witnessing weeks of protests over the rising cost of living, poor conditions in schools and strained public services. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has announced an early minimum wage increase and promised better pay for low-paid public sector workers. But unions say the measures fall short. With public debt touching 3.6 trillion euros and the budget deficit at 5.4% of GDP, France faces a difficult balancing act. Can the government address public anger without deepening the country's financial crisis? Palki Sharma explains.
